name: Skyward Strike
desc: A vertical-scrolling airplane shooter with escalating waves, five enemy types, a boss every fifth wave, combo scoring, power-ups, and synthesized audio. Original Canvas-drawn sprites; no asset files, build step, or runtime dependencies.
controls: Fly: arrows or WASD; fire: hold Space or Z; bomb: X or B; pause: P or Esc; mute: M. Touch/mouse: drag on the field to fly and auto-fire.
creator: CTBot000
